text:
sre-bot: [ALERT] phi1: control-plane packet loss spikes >95%, master nodes flapping, autoscaler failing to reconcile.

mira (oncall): taking this. what's the impact surface? ingress, model-serving, control plane? :eyes:

raj (infra): control plane and kube-apiserver... nodes showing OOM+evictions. metrics: etcd write latency high, kube-scheduler failing votes.

lia (network): BGP telemetry shows multiple uplink peers withdrawing prefixes from phi1 at 02:14 UTC. looks like an upstream ISP flap, not healthy routing.

sre-bot: related alerts: autoscaler-errors x42, etcd-quorum-lag x3, svc-discovery-errors in phi1. See logs:
```
[02:17:45] kube-apiserver ERROR: apiserver: dial tcp: i/o timeout
[02:17:48] etcd WARN: kvstore: leader lost 2 votes
```

ops-lead: automated failover to phx1 kicked but stuck on IPAM allocation step. Route53 updates throttled (rate-limited) and HAProxy configs not fully templated.

deploy-bot: DNS change attempted: change-id: Z123456789 / TTL 60. status: queued (rate limit).

mira (oncall): priorities: 1) stop further Evictions, 2) route traffic away from phi1, 3) bring up limited capacity in fallback with smaller model variants to preserve SLOs. I'll open a handoff if we need paging.

raj (infra): running quick checks, attaching outputs:
```
kubectl -n redwood get pods --field-selector=status.phase!=Running
NODE phi1-master-3 status: NotReady
IP pool phi1-internal: allocatable 0/1024 (exhausted)
```

lia (network): IPAM exhaustion is real — CNI plugin ran out of /24s after flaps created a bunch of orphaned allocations. Suggest reclaim script + temporary host-routing for fallback.

mira (oncall): can we fast-path a traffic shift? I want LB weights moved off phi1 now. @deploy-bot trigger weight-decrease phi1 -> 10% then to 0.

deploy-bot: command queued: `lb adjust --region phi1 --weight 10` -> started

eva (product): heads up: models using dedicated pools in phi1 will drop capacity; consider promoting smaller quantized variants to reduce GPU footprint.

raj (infra): starting ipam-reclaim job: `ipam-reclaim --dry-run` shows ~260 orphan IPs to free. will run with 10s throttle to avoid control-plane pressure.

ops-lead: we should also open a support ticket with upstream ISP for BGP flaps; lia, please paste peer AS details.

lia (network): peer ASNs: 64512, 64513. filing ticket now. ETA for first response ~20-30m.

mira (oncall): status update in 10m. current actions checklist:
- lb weight adjust phi1 -> 10% (in flight)
- ipam reclaim job (in progress)
- promote small model variants in phx1 (planning)
- open ISP ticket (lia)

sre-bot: note: failover automation flagged a gating condition: `ipam_exhausted` prevented full cutover. we've overridden to allow partial shift (manual) per oncall.

raj (infra): ipam reclaim completed: freed 280 IPs. control plane still flapping but some pods rescheduled.

deploy-bot: lb adjust phi1 -> 10% succeeded; next step auto to 0% scheduled in 2m.

mira (oncall): moving to escalation channel if control plane doesn't stabilize after full shift. tagging @ops-lead for postmortem owner.

ops-lead: noted. cost note: promoting fallback capacity in phx1 will incur burst GPU spend; we'll document for billing.

lia (network): ISP ticket opened: INC-987654. traceroute and BGP dumps attached.

mira (oncall): last update: phi1 traffic at ~8% load, control-plane still intermittent. continuing monitoring. next check 02:45 UTC.

sre-bot: thread closed to public channel; handoff to incidents-handoff at 3250004900 for next steps.
